## Checks

- [ ] `make lint test`
- [ ] `make acceptance DOTFILES=<dotfiles checkout>`, if the command line tool changed
- [ ] Screenshots from `WIDTH=1280 Scripts/snapshot.sh`, if the window changed, or `Scripts/snapshot.sh <folder> menubar-light`, if the menu bar did
- [ ] A line under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`, if a user would notice
- [ ] README.md still right

[AGENTS.md](https://github.com/JaviLorbada/devsweep/blob/main/AGENTS.md) has the project's rules.
